import numpy as np
def equation(eps, T, params):
    p = params
    L = np.log(eps)
    t1 = p[0]*T**2 + p[1]*T**3 + p[2]/T**2
    t2 = p[3]*T + p[4]*T**3 + p[5]*np.log(T)
    t3 = p[6] + p[7]*T**2
    return t1 + t2*L + t3/eps + p[8]*L**2 + p[9]*eps
